heading: Hey! Time for a little self-care
subheading: Take care of your eyes & body
closing_message: Your eyes and body deserve a break!

water.title: Drink Water
water.text: Take a few sips of water. Stay hydrated.

look_far.title: Look Far — {seconds} Seconds
look_far.text: Look at something about 20 feet (6 metres) away. Relax your eyes and blink normally.

move.title: Stand & Sit
move.text: Stand up, stretch gently and move a little. Sit back comfortably when you are ready.
